notes.title: Version 1.6.0 - New Leveling System + over 30 abilities
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45284724/cf395e480413191994e6a5f0240e3ecf5c84f038.png"]
Additions
New leveling system

Over 30 new abilities to unlock while leveling

Rogue-like style system where you start off each run at level 0 so you can create different builds each run.
QoL Changes
Revamp HUD

Add indicator when player is off screen

Better game to menu flow
Bugfixes
Fix jumping while stopping to move

notes.title: Version 1.3.0 - Multiplayer Overhaul
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45284724/209c89c65f942109721eb512a1348cf316a7998e.png"]


Bugfixes
Multiplayer is completely overhauled:

Level scroll stays in sync

Player, enemy and item positions are better synced

Volcano event stops spawning on top of itself

Online death match stats are now properly synced


QoL Changes
Menu flow got simplified

Character selection and online lobby are simplified

Load levels in background

notes.title: Version 1.1.0 - New levels and more!
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45284724/b3e69e3c8e7672644264a3f8196a7daf0f2a4cbb.png"]


Additions
3 new levels

Split keyboard and controller for player 1. So now you can play on the same device using a keyboard and controller.

Save settings on disk

Load certain elements later so that the game starts up faster.

Add movement to main menu background.

Make window smaller when going to windowed mode.
Bugfixes
Fix Discord button.

Fix scrolling with mouse in local single and multiplayer level select.

Make splash screen transition to main menu on more different types of input, mouse clicks for example.
